high_level_description: The image features a person sitting on a chair against a plain dark background. The individual is wearing a black flight suit with various patches and insignia. On the left side of the chest, there is a patch with an emblem that appears to be related to aviation or space exploration. Below this emblem, the name "JAHNAVI DANGETI" is embroidered in white text. On the right sleeve, there is a patch featuring the Indian flag, indicating a connection to India. The person has long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. They are smiling warmly, giving the image a friendly and approachable mood.
